description: Internal header for KYBER cryptographic functions in BoringSSL, defining constants, structures, and function prototypes related to Kyber encryption and hashing.

classes.name: BORINGSSL_keccak_st
classes.description: Structure representing the state of a Keccak hash operation.

methods.name: BORINGSSL_keccak
methods.description: Hashes input data using Keccak with specified configuration.

methods.name: BORINGSSL_keccak_init
methods.description: Initializes Keccak state with input data for squeezing.

methods.name: BORINGSSL_keccak_squeeze
methods.description: Produces output bytes from Keccak state.

methods.name: KYBER_generate_key_external_entropy
methods.description: Deterministically generates Kyber keys from supplied entropy (for testing).

methods.name: KYBER_encap_external_entropy
methods.description: Deterministically encapsulates shared secret using supplied entropy (for testing).
